fact: The first Libyan Experts Forum (23-25 August 2026, Tripoli) recommended expediting implementation of the "Digital Addressing Platform" project, which the Libya Herald reports as a project already being implemented.

Libya Post launched its postal addressing project at the start of 2025, installing address plates in a number of municipalities, with a first phase targeting numbering of 42,000 buildings and more than 23 municipalities to follow, as reported by the Libyan News Agency on 20 June 2025.
